persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a square logo for my bakery, Mooncrumb: a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds. No white box behind it.
bank.Design: A gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering.
bank.File format and background: PNG with actual transparency outside the logo, not a white box or checkerboard drawn into the image.

messages.text: Could you make a logo for my bakery? I’ve been excited about finally having a logo for it, so I’m probably explaining this in more detail than I need to. The bakery is called Mooncrumb, and I want the logo to be square. For the design, I’d like a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Please send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds. I don’t want a white box behind it.
